events.what_it_is: A free immersive bodega-themed pop-up celebrating NYC shop cats, with photo moments, games and cat-themed installations.
events.what_is_free: Free TEMPTATIONS cat-treat samples and chances to win exclusive Cat Bodega merchandise.
events.caveats: Physical NYC pop-up ends Sept. 19; the separate virtual Cat Bodega continues through Sept. 26. Merchandise/prizes are subject to availability.
events.practical_notes: Official TEMPTATIONS source confirms Sept. 17–19, 12 PM–6 PM daily at 213 Bowery and describes the physical pop-up as free.

events.what_it_is: Three-day SACHEU beauty pop-up with product consultations, games, prizes, product try-ons and an immersive skylight installation.
events.what_is_free: Free attendance; event materials advertise a free full-size product for attendees while supplies last, plus games and prizes. Gifts with purchase are a separate offer.
events.caveats: The event fine print explicitly says RSVP does not guarantee entry, attendance, or a reserved place in line. Entry is first come, first served and subject to venue capacity. Products and promotional items are while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 18–20, 11 AM–5 PM daily at 541 W 25th St. RSVP is for communications/planning and does not control admission.

events.what_it_is: DedCool's first cafe and retail pop-up, celebrating the Mocha Magic fragrance with cafe drinks, fragrance sampling and exclusive merchandise.
events.what_is_free: Fragrance sampling and a special gift for the first 50 people in line each day; other gifts may require purchase.
events.caveats: The hosted Partiful has a guest list, while current event guidance says the pop-up is open to walk-ins. Treat RSVP as optional rather than guaranteed/reserved admission. First-50 gifts are limited daily.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 18–20, 9 AM–6 PM daily at 262 Mott Street. The hosted event page is live and current.

events.event_name: A Drop of Japan: Apothékary × SUKOSHI Pop-Up
events.what_it_is: Three-day wellness pop-up with tongue readings, tincture sampling, ingredient education and Japanese kakigori shaved ice.
events.what_is_free: Tincture sampling and kakigori while supplies last; the first 50 guests in line each day receive a mini Apothékary tincture.
events.caveats: Free items are while supplies last. A 20% event discount and gift-with-purchase offer are separate from free attendance/sampling. Current listings route attendees through a free Eventbrite registration path; no organizer-selection requirement was established.
events.practical_notes: Friday Sept. 18: 1–9 PM. Saturday Sept. 19 and Sunday Sept. 20: 9 AM–9 PM. 1542 3rd Avenue.

events.address: Shopify NY, 131 Greene Street, New York, NY 10012
events.what_it_is: Heaven Mayhem's first brick-and-mortar pop-up, featuring eyewear, jewelry and accessories at Shopify NY.
events.what_is_free: Opening-day free matcha for the first 100 guests; gifts with purchase from partner brands are separate purchase-conditioned offers.
events.caveats: Free matcha is limited to the first 100 guests on Sept. 18. Partner gifts are gifts with purchase. No advance reservation requirement was established by the current event listing.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 18: 2–6 PM. Sept. 19–20: 11 AM–6 PM. Shopify NY, 131 Greene Street.
